content:
Rina (Design): quick eye on the pool selector + SLO slider copy. proposal: add a focused state that shows a short "impact line" under the selector: "Likely impact: +$X/hr, latency +Yms". mock: https://figma.com/file/xxxxx/pool-focus
Theo (PM): good. also want the selector to surface pool tags (e.g., gpu-vendor, region) in the focused panel. users ask that when switching pools.
Omar (Frontend): implementable. will render a small details row when the selector has aria-focus. question: should the impact line show for pool switch only or for min/max changes too?
Rina (Design): both. consistency helps. keep wording simple: use "Likely impact" header. avoid technical words like "delta".
Leo (A11y): accessibility: ensure the focused panel is reachable by keyboard and announced. use aria-live for the impact line and include a text label for the pool tags for screen readers. avoid hover-only reveals.
Mina (Infra): infra note: pool switch preview must use cached perf profiles to avoid hitting the model metrics API repeatedly. also flag if switching pools will trigger a model move that could take minutes. show that as a clear warning.
Theo (PM): copy for the warning: "Switching pools may pause traffic while instances re-provision (estimated 2-5 min)." short and actionable.
Omar (Frontend): will include a small status pill when a pool is selected: e.g., "warm" / "cold" with offscreen text explaining it. status pill must be readable by SR.
Rina (Design): microcopy candidates for impact header: ["Likely impact", "Estimated impact", "Preview"]. I prefer "Likely impact".
Leo (A11y): prefer "Estimated impact" because "likely" is vague for SR users. but both ok if explained. ensure we provide numeric context.
Theo (PM): pick "Estimated impact" to align with other console language.
Rina (Design): ok will switch to "Estimated impact". also will shorten pool tag display: show vendor + region, and a "more" button for full details.
Mina (Infra): when user confirms a pool switch, server should return a firm estimate of reprovision time. include audit logging for pool switches.
Omar (Frontend): timeline: I'll prototype the focused panel with aria-live + pill states this sprint. will scope cached profile lookup and show the reprovision warning only when necessary.
ci-bot: scheduled deploy: pool-focus-estimates -> staging on 2026-05-04 11:00 UTC :rocket:
Rina (Design): great. i'll update figma and push the copy updates. thanks!
